description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing surveys in the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to retrieve, create, and delete survey data, as well as get survey summaries and register new survey tables. The class is annotated with JAX-RS annotations for routing and Swagger annotations for API documentation, and uses dependency injection to include various service components.

classes.name: SurveyApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing surveys, including retrieval, creation, and deletion of survey data.

methods.name: retrieveSurveys
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all registered surveys.

methods.name: retrieveSurvey
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific survey by name.

methods.name: createDatatableEntry
methods.description: Creates a new entry in a survey table (full fill the survey).

methods.name: getClientSurveyOverview
methods.description: Retrieves survey score overview for a specific client and survey.

methods.name: getSurveyEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific survey entry for a given client and entry ID.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new survey table with an application table.

methods.name: deleteDatatableEntries
methods.description: Deletes a survey entry for a given survey, client, and fulfilled ID.
